info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Payment Cheque Processing-spec
info.description: The Cheque Processing API allows businesses to automate and manage the processing of cheque payments efficiently. By utilizing this API, financial institutions and payment service providers can streamline cheque payment submissions, validate payment details, and handle transaction statuses seamlessly. Typical consumers include banks, accounting software, and payment platforms looking to improve their cheque processing capabilities. This API enhances operational efficiency and provides a reliable solution for cheque transactions in the banking ecosystem.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to process payments made via cheque. Ensure that all cheque information is provided and valid before submission.
